description: This Java source file defines the main Spring Boot application class for JWQL Modernization. It sets up the application's entry point and configures OpenAPI documentation with metadata such as title, version, description, and contact information. It also includes package imports related to Spring Boot and OpenAPI, and defines a class with main() and a bean method for API configuration.
